name: Architecture AI
workflowStage: integration into design workflow for real-time feedback and visualization
tagline: A curated index of the studio's architecture-specific AI stack.
description: A reference index covering six topics in AI-assisted architecture — sketch-to-render, ControlNet, LoRA training, Revit+AI, AI video, and failure modes — each pointing to the tool or doc that covers it, plus the canonical pipeline documentation. It renders nothing and validates nothing itself; it is a map to the tools that do.

page.objective: Give designers, visualisers, and BIM staff one place to find the AI tools and docs relevant to architecture work.
page.solution: A short reference page and README indexing six topics — sketch-to-render, ControlNet, LoRA, Revit+AI, AI video, failure modes — each linking out to the tool or documentation that covers it.

highlights.headline: A curated knowledge index for the studio's AI-visualization pipeline.
points: Indexes six topics: sketch-to-render, ControlNet, LoRA, Revit+AI, AI video, failure modes.
Points to the canonical pipeline doc rather than running any pipeline itself.
Not a build — a 98-line reference page plus a README index.
